name: VCBImprovements
description: A collection of small quality-of-life improvements for Virtual Circuit Board. #1 - Drag Override: while simulating, click-drag across separate latches to toggle (or press-and-hold) each one the pointer sweeps over, so a whole row of switches flips in one drag. A checkbox under the Toggle/Press buttons in the simulation panel turns it on (sim-only; keeps its state across sim restarts). Multiplayer-compatible: the swept overrides are mirrored to the other player so both boards stay in lockstep. Pure GDScript, loads at runtime, never replaces vcb.pck; coexists with other mods.
